page.notes: The page is a dense two-column index; the right column reads across the same lines as the left, and the printed text was transcribed line by line as set in the two columns. Several words in the index are doubtful, notably the left-column entries near "sr-iant" and the right-column entries near "præsuch nunciæ", and are unreliable. Marked spots: the entries "Principibus" through "Cardinalium" and the signature. Remaining words were read with uncertainty and may contain errors.
